data.content: PATTERN: Config-error must short-circuit BEFORE the default fallback to avoid silent fallback. resolveProviderConcurrencyLimit returns {source,error} on malformed config (:573); checkProviderConcurrencyForDispatch returns provider-concurrency-config-error (:615-624) before reaching DEFAULT_API_PROVIDER_CONCURRENCY_LIMITS. Tests assert spawn NOT called on both the limit and config-error paths.
